title: RuneScape Dragonwilds: Velgar Boss Fight – Solo Melee Only (No Commentary)
author: Zeroster Gaming
description:
A solo boss fight against Velgar in RuneScape Dragonwilds. This 1080p gameplay captures the entire encounter, showing all attack patterns, phases, and Velgar’s deadly fire-breathing mechanics.

Perfect for players who want to learn how to defeat Velgar, study its combat strategies, or simply enjoy a clean, no-commentary boss battle.
